lastResponse.text: Thank you for telling me clearly. You’re not saying you want to die or hurt anyone, but this is still a mental health crisis, and you deserve immediate help. I’m connecting you to a live crisis counselor now. If your safety changes at any point, call nine one one right away. You can also call Clackamas 24/7 Mobile Crisis at 503, 655, 8585.
